first_step_test: A single hand-drawn circle fixes the marble's size and final position, so every interior line has a visible boundary to follow.

source.notes: Five-panel handmade pencil contact sheet; rejected iterations, if any, remain in drafts.

final_elements.name: outer marble circle
final_elements.description: One uneven round graphite outline centered on the page.

final_elements.name: ribbon front edge
final_elements.description: One flowing S curve from upper-left interior to lower-right interior.

final_elements.name: ribbon rear edge
final_elements.description: A parallel S curve that gives the central ribbon its width and meets the outer rim at both ends.

final_elements.name: two ribbon fold marks
final_elements.description: Two short curved fold lines within the ribbon, one above and one below center.

final_elements.name: two glass highlights
final_elements.description: Two short curved highlight gaps near the upper-right and lower-left inner rim.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: One short broken oval graphite shadow directly beneath the marble.

frames.visible_job: Draw one imperfect round outer contour.
frames.instruction: Lightly draw a round marble in the middle of the page with a slightly uneven pencil line; keep its lower edge just above where the shadow will sit.

frames.visible_job: Add the first flowing inner S curve.
frames.instruction: Start at the upper-left inside rim and sweep a gentle S curve through the middle to the lower-right rim.

frames.visible_job: Add a second parallel S curve with fixed endpoints.
frames.instruction: Run a second S curve beside the first, leaving a broad ribbon between them; join its ends near the same upper-left and lower-right rim points.

frames.visible_job: Add two short curved fold lines within the ribbon.
frames.instruction: Place one short curved fold above the ribbon center and another below it, both staying between the two long ribbon edges.

frames.visible_job: Add two slim glass reflections and one broken shadow under the marble.
frames.instruction: Trace two slim curved glass reflections, one near the upper-right inner rim and one near the lower-left inner rim. Sketch a broken oval shadow beneath the circle.

final_step.visible_job: Shade existing contours and the established ribbon and shadow without adding structure.
final_step.instruction: Deepen the lower rim and broken shadow with graphite. Shade the established ribbon lightly with muted blue pencil, keeping both reflection areas pale and every earlier curve visible.
adds: graphite and muted blue shading on established contours

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved square crop contains only one imperfect centered graphite circle, leaving a clear interior for the swirl and white space beneath for its shadow.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Six saved square crops build one fixed marble from circle to two S ribbon edges, two fold marks, two reflection marks and one broken shadow before restrained graphite and blue pencil shading. No temporary guides or unexplained structural loss appear.

transitions.observed_addition: The circle stays centered while one long S curve runs from its upper-left inner rim to the lower-right inner rim.
transitions.instruction_match: The second instruction matches this single new sweeping curve.

transitions.observed_addition: The same circle and first S remain; a parallel S starts near the upper-left rim and ends beside the first at the lower-right rim, defining one broad ribbon.
transitions.instruction_match: The third instruction matches the second fixed ribbon edge.

transitions.observed_addition: Both long ribbon edges persist; one short inner bend appears in the upper ribbon and one in its lower bend.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth instruction matches the two small folds inside the ribbon.

transitions.observed_addition: The circle, ribbon and two folds persist; one upper-right reflection, one lower-left reflection and a broken oval shadow below the circle appear.
transitions.instruction_match: The fifth instruction matches both reflections and the shadow, with white paper beside the reflection strokes.

transitions.observed_addition: All contours, folds, reflections and the broken shadow persist; muted blue pencil fills the ribbon and graphite darkens the rim and shadow.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction adds only color and value on established geometry.
